title: VPN Connection Timeout - GlobalProtect Gateway Unreachable
possibleCause: Stale gateway profile or client firewall blocking port 443.
prerequisites: Ensure active internet connection outside VPN.

steps.text: Open GlobalProtect settings, go to Network, and select Refresh Connection.
If unresolved, clear DNS cache using 'ipconfig /flushdns' in command prompt.

escalationCondition: Escalate to Network Operations if error code ERR_GATEWAY_UNREACHABLE persists after DNS flush.

title: Payroll Portal Authentication Failure After Password Reset (AUTH-401)
possibleCause: Directory password synchronization delay across identity domain controllers.
prerequisites: Use approved identity verification procedure before supporting account reset.

steps.text: Verify directory password synchronization status for the affected user.
Instruct user to clear browser cache and stored web credentials.
Have user attempt login again using the updated domain credentials.

validation: User successfully logs into Payroll Portal without AUTH-401 prompt.
escalationCondition: Escalate to Identity Operations if more than 5 users remain affected after 15 minutes.

title: Database Connection Pool Exhaustion (ERR_DB_POOL_EXHAUSTED)
possibleCause: Unclosed HikariCP database connections in backend microservice under high batch load.

steps.text: Check active HikariCP connection count metrics on the Grafana dashboard.
Restart affected backend application node to release leaked connections.

validation: HikariPool active connections return to normal baseline (<15 active).
escalationCondition: Escalate to Database Administration if pool exhausts again within 30 minutes.

title: SAP ERP License Key Expiration Notice (LIC-902)
possibleCause: Annual SAP enterprise license key expired on host server.
prerequisites: Check license status in transaction SLICENSE.

steps.text: Log into SAP GUI with SAP* administrator credentials.
Run transaction code SLICENSE and import renewed license key file.

validation: Transaction SLICENSE shows valid status with future expiration date.
escalationCondition: Escalate to IT Procurement if renewed key file is invalid or missing.

title: Outlook Search Indexing Failure & Missing Emails
symptoms: Recent emails not found in search
possibleCause: Corrupted Windows Search Index catalog file.
prerequisites: Close Microsoft Outlook completely before troubleshooting.

steps.text: Open Control Panel -> Indexing Options -> Advanced.
Click 'Rebuild' under Index Settings and confirm prompt.

escalationCondition: Escalate to Desktop Support if rebuild option is grayed out.
